-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.backend.InvSnapshot` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def backend.viewAt (γ : backend.BNames) (vd : backend.VData) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L, backend.viewQ γ (Qp.half 1).half vd L)

theorem backend.viewAt_bView (γ : backend.BNames) (vd vd' : backend.VData) (q : Qp) : backend.viewAt
    γ vd ∗ backend.bView γ q vd' ⊢ backend.viewAt γ vd ∗ backend.bView γ q vd' ∗ backend.thinV γ vd
    vd'

def backend.snapOpenQ (sp : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (γ : GName) (q : Qp) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ backend.snapRO sp D γ ∗ ghostVar γ q ())

def (sealed) backend.readerStreams (r : GoInterface) (Φ : List w8 → Prop) : IProp GF

def (sealed) backend.pathOwn (p : GoString) : IProp GF

def backend.snapOpen (sp : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γ, backend.snapOpenQ sp D γ 1)

theorem backend.writerOk_persistent (w : GoInterfaceOk) (Wr : Bool → List w8 → IProp GF) :
    Persistent (backend.writerOk w Wr)

def (sealed) backend.boltImage (bs : List w8) (D : backend.Data) : Prop

def (sealed) backend.snapRO (sp : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (γ : GName) : IProp GF

def backend.writerOk (w : GoInterfaceOk) (Wr : Bool → List w8 → IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ p dq chunk bs c,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            ownSlice p chunk dq ∗ Wr c bs -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ n err,
                    (∃ k,
                        ownSlice p chunk dq ∗
                          Wr true (bs ++ List.take k chunk) ∗
                            ⌜sint.Z n = ↑k ∧ k ≤ chunk.length ∧ (err = GoInterface.nil → k = chunk.length)⌝) -∗
                      Φ (intoVal n, intoVal err)) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods w.ty go!"Write" w.v)) (intoVal p)) {{ Φ }})

theorem backend.snapOpenQ_half (sp : Loc) (D : backend.Data) (γ : GName) (q : Qp) :
    backend.snapOpenQ sp D γ q ⊣⊢ backend.snapOpenQ sp D γ q.half ∗ backend.snapOpenQ sp D γ q.half

def (sealed) backend.renameOk (src dst : GoString) : Prop

theorem backend.viewAt_noDel (γ : backend.BNames) (vd : backend.VData) : backend.dlNoDel γ ∗
    backend.viewAt γ vd ⊢ ghostVar γ.view (Qp.half 1).half vd
